derivation_rules.statement: A PDF execution's diagnostics are the case's approved SVG declaration in order, each with format rewritten to "pdf"; official PNG is not authoritative where formats differ.

derivation_rules.statement: Only codes in the format table transfer; any other declared code fails derivation until a spec-anchored format rule is added.
The PNG declaration must equal the SVG declaration minus PNG-silent codes, format rewritten to "png"; otherwise the two approved declarations disagree beyond the spec's format rules.

derivation_rules.spec_anchor: A standalone empty report is exactly this JSON, with no trailing LF:
derivation_rules.statement: Typography and frame manifests carry one expected report for every format; it is transferred only when it is the canonical empty report, which has no format member.

derivation_rules.spec_anchor: `AllowIsolated` emits exactly one `pdf.raster-fallback` warning per emitted
derivation_rules.statement: pdf.* diagnostics exist only in PDF and are never inferred: each case carries an explicit declaration (possibly empty) inserted at insert_at. A scene whose nested SVG payload contains a pixel-domain filter must declare its pdf.raster-fallback warnings.

Report bytes are minified schema-1 JSON in the declared member order: schema_version, diagnostics; diagnostic members code, severity, format, effects, element_id, json_pointer, message, details; details members in the order of their closed kind.
